market.question: Will there be exactly 2 major space weather events this week?

assessment.reasoning: Question asks for EXACTLY 2 G3+/S3+/R3+ events between May 3-9. Solar activity is elevated (active sunspot regions AR4425/AR4420, recent M-class flares, R1 already noted May 5). Forecasts mention G3 storms in second week of May. Base rate of exactly 2 strong events per week during solar maximum is moderate but probability is split between 0/1/3+ events.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether forecast G3 storms materialize; exact count over single week is high variance.
